messages:
Maya: noticed a weird line on the Feb invoice — two separate entries for GPU hours on project redwood-dedicated-1 for the same date range. one is the usual 'accelerator usage: nVidia-A100' and another is 'EOL accelerator surcharge' with a similar qty. anyone else seen this?
Sam: ack, saw a small spike yesterday but assumed autoscaling churn. can you paste the invoice line?
Maya: yes, snippet: `invoice# INV-2026-02-13 line: gce.accelerator.usage A100 720hrs $12,960` then `invoice# INV-2026-02-13 line: gce.accelerator.eol_tax A100 720hrs $1,296` — same zone, same project, same resource label set.
Lee: that "eol_tax" label looks like a new billing product from the provider — maybe region-specific regulatory fee? but provider shouldn't double-count usage.
Jordi: FYI billing-bot forwarded a provider notice last week about 'hardware decommission tax' in eu-west1 but it said it would appear as an aggregate tax, not duplicate usage lines.
billing-bot: provider-notice: id=PN-2412 "Hardware End-of-Life surcharge introduced in EU regions, applies to discontinued accelerator SKUs. Full details: https://cloud.example.com/PN-2412"
Sam: quick check: are these VMs under our Dedicated reservation pool? if so, reserved capacity should reduce on-demand charges, maybe credits applied separately and this new line bypasses reservation logic.
Maya: both instances are attached to the Dedicated pool (reservation id res-62). our commitment usage report shows the reservation consumed for those hours.
Lee: can you run `gcloud billing accounts get-usage --start=2026-02-01 --end=2026-02-28 --filter="project:redwood-dedicated-1 AND sku:accelerator"` and share totals?
Maya: pasting output: `sku:accelerator usage: 720.0 hours cost: 12960.00` and then `sku:EOL-ACCELERATOR-FEE usage: 720.0 cost: 1296.00` — same usage metric.
Sam: that strongly suggests the provider emitted a new SKU that mirrors usage and is billed separately rather than as a percentage tax. weird. could be a bug in their billing pipeline.
Jordi: I can open a ticket, but need invoice IDs, line numbers, and sample resource ids. Maya, can you add resource labels for one of the affected VMs?
Maya: done — attached `resource_id: instance-mlserv-12 zone:eu-west1-b labels:{env:prod,pool:dedicated-res}`
Lee: also check if the reservation discount was applied to the accelerator usage line but not to the EOL line. that would explain the extra $1.3k.
Maya: reservation credit applied to `gce.accelerator.usage` (credit -$10,368) but no credit on `gce.accelerator.eol_tax`. final invoice net increased by $1,296.
Sam: two hypotheses: 1) provider intentionally excluded the EOL SKU from commitment discounts, 2) provider mis-tagged the EOL line as a distinct resource causing our CUD/commitment matching to miss it.
Jordi: ticket submitted to provider support #SUP-78321 with attached invoice pdfs and `gcloud` exports. asked them to confirm whether the EOL SKU should be covered by existing reservations/committed use discounts.
billing-bot: support-update SUP-78321 status: acknowledged by vendor. expected response 72h.
Maya: need to decide immediately whether to absorb the cost temporarily or submit a dispute to cloud billing to avoid recognition in our MTD spend. finance prefers dispute if vendor error.
Lee: we should also check cross-project leakage: sometimes we run identical workloads in a secondary project where reservations don't apply. double-check the project IDs encoded in the lineitem.
Maya: confirmed: both lineitems reference project `redwood-dedicated-1` and the same `billingAccountId`.
Sam: while we wait, add a short-term alert: if any new invoices include sku "EOL-ACCELERATOR-FEE" > $0 then page infra-oncall and finance. we don't want surprise repeats.
Lee: good call. I'll add a Billing Alert rule that parses lineitems for SKU regex `(?i)eol.*accelerator` and threshold > 10 USD.
Maya: also, cashflow ask: should we retroactively claim credits for previous months if provider rolled this out silently? finance wants to check Jan and Dec invoices.
Jordi: provider thread says rollout started 2026-01-15. I'll request they re-run Jan invoices if it was generated erroneously before rollout.
Maya: assigned action items: 1) Jordi - push for credit or invoice reissue (SUP-78321), 2) Lee - add alert + verify reservation matching logic for new SKU, 3) Sam - confirm no autoscaling spawned VMs outside reservation pool, 4) Maya - prepare accounting dispute package if vendor refuses.
Sam: ETA on autoscale check: 2h.
Lee: alert created and PR merged `infra/billing-alerts#452`.
Jordi: provider replied: they acknowledged the EOL SKU and confirmed it is currently not included in our committed pricing tier. they're escalating for billing reclassification.
Maya: ok please keep updates in this thread and add invoice # and credits if they patch. finance will withhold recognition until we either get reissue or formal dispute. :+1:
Sam: noted. also adding a short-term tagging requirement so any new GPU instances include `billing:dedicated-reservation` label to help matching.
Maya: thanks everyone. if vendor offers pro-rated credit we'll reconcile in Feb close.
billing-bot: support-update SUP-78321 status: escalated to billing-engineering. expected update by 2026-02-20."
